provenance: Gold PMIDs were identified by field-restricted phrase search against the LIVE Europe PMC API (TITLE_ABS phrase queries, CITED desc), and each title was read to confirm the paper is genuinely about the mechanism named. They were NOT selected by running the local index, so neither arm of the evaluation chose its own answers. Membership in the corpus was verified independently against corpus/atlas/identity.sqlite: 10 of the 11 papers first identified are held; PMID 37358255 is not, and was dropped rather than counted as a retrieval failure.
known_bias: Because the gold was found by phrase search, every gold paper is guaranteed to contain its mechanism phrase. That favours arm B, which searches for phrases. The evaluation therefore measures whether phrasing plus field weighting can recover a paper the corpus demonstrably holds -- known-item retrieval -- and does NOT claim to measure precision over unjudged results.
